description: A protective magical force surrounds a creature who isn't wearing armor: its base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier for 8 hours (until a long rest here).
srd_description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.
